Definition: Joab, the name of three Israelites
BiblicalUsage: Joab = "Jehovah is father"; 1) son of David's sister Zeruiah and general of David's army; 2) a Judaite descendant of Kenaz; 3) a post exilic family
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
